acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: submit rejects a new request whose workId already exists under a different idempotencyKey with deterministic WORK_ID_CONFLICT, while an exact idempotency replay remains idempotent and cannot create a second record.

confirmed: Stored duplicate work IDs are treated as invalid persistence and fail closed; runDue updates only the selected batch records and cannot apply one dispatch result to an out-of-batch or future record.

confirmed: runDue obtains its scheduling timestamp only from the trusted clock port; caller-supplied timestamps are rejected or ignored without authority, a far-future caller value cannot dispatch future work, and invalid or unavailable clock output fails closed.

confirmed: After construction, mutations or replacement of the caller's limits, clock, storage, or dispatcher properties do not change the validated configuration used by the module; the captured limits and callable ports are frozen/snapshotted.

confirmed: Dispatcher input includes the queue idempotencyKey for every work item, and documentation states the current dispatch-before-persist behavior is at-least-once in Tier-0/shadow mode with no exactly-once claim or production adapter authority.

confirmed: Focused regression tests cover duplicate work IDs, caller-clock disagreement, post-construction port mutation, idempotency-key propagation, persistence failure after dispatch, malformed inputs, and the existing event-delivery contract without introducing infrastructure imports or production behavior.
